components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action button for primary conversion pathways (e.g. Book Consultation).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">BOOK CONSULTATION <svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E2E2E2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2E2E2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered button for secondary actions such as viewing case studies.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; background: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Minimal text action with zero padding for subtle navigation or card links.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Executive Card
components.description: Glassmorphic container with hairline border and dark ambient glow on hover.
components.html:
METRIC 01

Revenue Acceleration

Quantitative optimization models unlocking 34% margin improvement across global business units.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); padding: 32px; border-radius: 0; color: #EDEDED; transition: background-color 500ms ease, border-color 500ms ease, box-shadow 500ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 50px -12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 0 0 12px 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); margin: 0; }

components.name: Architectural Input
components.description: Minimal hairline underline input with subtle placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 0; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #FFFFFF; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 300ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); font-weight: 300; }

components.name: Time Slot Chip
components.description: Interactive time slot selector showing default state and active Bronze state.
components.css: .ds-slot-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-slot { padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; background: transparent; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-slot:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-slot-active { background: #C0A062; color: #000000; border-color: #C0A062; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The Consult Inc. design system synthesizes high-finance institutional authority, cinematic dark minimalism, and architectural rigor. Built specifically for C-suite decision-makers and board-level executives, every interaction is engineered to feel deliberate, heavy, and composed. The interface operates as a digital extension of an executive boardroom: austere obsidian backgrounds, razor-sharp hairlines, generous negative space, and luminous metallic accents.

Rather than relying on sterile corporate templates or casual SaaS aesthetics, the design language treats whitespace as a luxury material. Surfaces remain disciplined and calm, avoiding clutter, noisy banners, or gratuitous color bursts. The visual cadence alternates between commanding editorial serif statements and dense, high-precision monospace data points.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome Foundation: Native deep midnight canvas (#050505) with deliberate grayscale tonal layering.
Precious Accent Rarity: Burnished Bronze (#C0A062) is strictly rationed for active calendar slots and verified indicators.
Architectural Geometry: Predominantly 0px corner radiuses with razor-sharp planar precision.
Filmic Physicality: Continuous 3% fixed SVG noise layer over the viewport providing tangible physical grain.
Typographic Polarity: Playfair Display for authoritative editorial headlines contrasted against JetBrains Mono for clinical operational metrics.

rules.name: The Bronze Restraint Rule
rules.body: Burnished Bronze is reserved strictly for active states, selected calendar dates, and high-value indicators (≤5% visual presence; its rarity preserves impact and luxury).

rules.name: The Native Dark Rule
rules.body: The application operates natively in dark mode without light-mode switching; luxury is defined by controlled luminance on deep obsidian backgrounds.

rules.name: The Monospace Provenance Rule
rules.body: All metrics, dates, categories, and administrative sub-labels must render in JetBrains Mono uppercase with wide tracking (0.15em) to impart institutional data rigor.

rules.name: The Editorial Heading Rule
rules.body: All major headings (H1–H3) must utilize Playfair Display with tight letter-spacing; sans-serif is strictly forbidden for top-level titles.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Tetris Rule
rules.body: Marketing and showcase hero sections favor 12-column asymmetric grids (8-column statement, 4-column interactive unit) over generic centered card stacks.

rules.name: The Abundance Spacing Rule
rules.body: Spacing favors generous breathing room; where standard SaaS layouts deploy 16px padding, executive luxury employs 48px to 80px.

rules.name: The No-Drop-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Heavy, murky drop shadows are prohibited; depth is achieved exclusively through translucent glass layering, hairline borders, and subtle luminous ambient glow.

rules.name: The Filmic Texture Rule
rules.body: A fixed 3% opacity fractal noise overlay runs continuously across the viewport to add cinematic physical grain to dark digital surfaces.

rules.name: The Razor Form Rule
rules.body: Structural containers, buttons, cards, dialogs, and inputs adhere strictly to 0px border radius (sharp rectangular geometry).

dos: Do use Playfair Display for all H1, H2, and H3 titles with tight letter-spacing.
Do format technical metrics, dates, and category pills in uppercase JetBrains Mono with wide tracking (tracking-widest).
Do reserve Burnished Bronze (#C0A062) strictly for active states, selected dates, and rare high-value signals.
Do maintain generous negative space, favoring p-12 to p-20 on key sections.
Do keep primary buttons and interactive containers razor-sharp with rounded-none.
Do use targeted CSS transitions (transition-colors duration-300 or transition-transform duration-500 ease-out).
donts: Don't introduce rounded corners (>4px) on cards, inputs, dialogs, or buttons.
Don't use multi-color gradient fills (e.g., purple-to-blue or cyan-to-violet 'AI-slop' aesthetics).
Don't use heavy black drop shadows; depth must come from tonal layering and hairline borders.
Don't use transition-all; always specify individual transitioning properties.
Don't center-align narrative paragraphs or body copy.
Don't add a light-mode toggle; the design system is native dark mode by definition.
